choose.when: SELECT 'project' AS "targetType",p.PROJ_ID AS "targetId",p.PROJ_NM AS "targetName", to_char(p.CTRT_BGN_DT,'YYYYMM') AS "startMonth",to_char(p.CTRT_END_DT,'YYYYMM') AS "endMonth", p.PROJ_STAT_CD AS "status",p.CTRT_TYPE_CD AS "contractTypeCode",p.CUST_CLNT_ID AS "customerId", c.INDUTY_CD AS "industryCode",p.WORK_AREA_CD AS "workAreaCode",p.FEATURE_CN AS "feature", p.PROJ_ID AS "projectId" FROM TB_PJ_PROJ p LEFT JOIN TB_BS_CLNT c ON c.CLNT_ID=p.CUST_CLNT_ID WHERE p.PROJ_ID=#{id}
choose.otherwise: SELECT 'opportunity' AS "targetType",o.OPP_ID AS "targetId",o.OPP_NM AS "targetName", o.BGN_PLAN_YM AS "startMonth",NULL::text AS "endMonth",o.OPP_STAT_CD AS "status", o.CTRT_TYPE_CD AS "contractTypeCode",o.CUST_CLNT_ID AS "customerId",c.INDUTY_CD AS "industryCode", o.WORK_AREA_CD AS "workAreaCode",o.RMRK AS "feature",o.PROJ_ID AS "projectId" FROM TB_SL_OPP o LEFT JOIN TB_BS_CLNT c ON c.CLNT_ID=o.CUST_CLNT_ID WHERE o.OPP_ID=#{id}

mapper.sql: SELECT d.DEV_ID AS "developerId",d.DEV_NM AS "developerName",d.MNG_NO AS "managementNumber", d.JOB_CD AS "jobCode",d.SUB_JOB_CD AS "subJobCode",COALESCE(j.CODE_NM,d.JOB_CD) AS "jobName", d.GRADE_CD AS "gradeCode",COALESCE(g.CODE_NM,'–') AS "gradeName",d.EMP_TYPE_CD AS "employeeTypeCode", COALESCE(e.CODE_NM,d.EMP_TYPE_CD) AS "employeeTypeName",d.HOME_AREA_CD AS "homeAreaCode" FROM TB_HR_DEV d LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE j ON j.CODE_GRP_ID='JOB' AND j.CODE=d.JOB_CD LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE g ON g.CODE_GRP_ID='GRADE' AND g.CODE=d.GRADE_CD LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE e ON e.CODE_GRP_ID='EMP_TYPE' AND e.CODE=d.EMP_TYPE_CD
mapper.select:
WHERE d.USE_YN='Y' AND d.DRCT_CLS_CD='DRCT' AND (d.JNCMP_DT IS NULL OR d.JNCMP_DT <= #{lastDay}) AND (d.RETIRE_DT IS NULL OR d.RETIRE_DT > #{lastDay}) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_HR_DEV_STAT s WHERE s.DEV_ID=d.DEV_ID AND s.WORK_STAT_CD='LEAVE' AND s.BGN_DT <= #{lastDay} AND (s.END_DT IS NULL OR s.END_DT >= #{firstDay})) AND NOT (d.WORK_STAT_CD IN ('RETIRE','LEAVE') AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM TB_HR_DEV_STAT s WHERE s.DEV_ID=d.DEV_ID AND s.WORK_STAT_CD='LEAVE')) AND (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(m.MON_MM),0) FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_MON m JOIN TB_PJ_ASGN a ON a.ASGN_ID=m.ASGN_ID AND a.ASGN_STAT_CD='ACT' WHERE m.DEV_ID=d.DEV_ID AND m.INPUT_YM=replace(#{condition.startMonth},'-','')) < 1
AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_SL_TENT_ASGN t WHERE t.DEV_ID=d.DEV_ID AND t.OPP_ID=#{condition.targetId} AND t.TENT_STAT_CD='ACT')
AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_SL_RCMD_LOG l WHERE l.DEV_ID=d.DEV_ID AND l.JOB_CD=#{condition.jobCode} AND l.USER_ACT_CD='EXCL' AND CASE WHEN left(l.SCORE_DTL,6)='{"v":1' THEN (l.SCORE_DTL::jsonb->>'e')='true' ELSE false END AND l.PROJ_ID=#{condition.targetId} AND l.OPP_ID=#{condition.targetId}) ORDER BY d.MNG_NO,d.DEV_ID

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE a.INPUT_END_DT < #{today})::int AS "endedCount", COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE a.INPUT_END_DT < #{today} AND a.EXT_CNT > 0)::int AS "extendedCount", COALESCE(SUM((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_HIST h WHERE h.ASGN_ID=a.ASGN_ID AND h.ASGN_CHG_TYPE_CD='EARLY' AND h.ASGN_CHG_RSN_CD='HR' AND h.CRCT_YN='N' AND h.APLY_DT <= #{today})) FILTER(WHERE a.INPUT_END_DT < #{today}),0)::int AS "hrWithdrawalCount", COALESCE(bool_or(p.CUST_CLNT_ID=#{customerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),false) AS "sameCustomer", COALESCE(bool_or(c.INDUTY_CD=#{industryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),false) AS "sameIndustry", MAX(a.INPUT_END_DT) FILTER(WHERE a.ASGN_STAT_CD='ACT') AS "withdrawalDate", COALESCE(bool_and(a.EXT_PSBL_CD='L') FILTER(WHERE a.ASGN_STAT_CD='ACT' AND a.INPUT_END_DT >= #{firstDay}),false) AS "lowExtension" FROM TB_PJ_ASGN a JOIN TB_PJ_PROJ p ON p.PROJ_ID=a.PROJ_ID LEFT JOIN TB_BS_CLNT c ON c.CLNT_ID=p.CUST_CLNT_ID WHERE a.DEV_ID=#{developerId} AND a.ASGN_STAT_CD!='CNCL' AND a.INPUT_BGN_DT <= #{today}

SELECT p.PAY_YM AS "yearMonth",p.DEV_ID AS "developerId",p.EMP_TYPE_CD AS "employeeTypeCode", p.PAY_AMT AS "salary",p.ALWNC_AMT AS "allowance",p.INSR_CMPNY_AMT AS "companyInsurance", p.RETIRE_RSV_AMT AS "retirementReserve",p.INSR_SELF_AMT AS "personalInsurance", p.WTHLD_TAX_AMT AS "withholdingTax",p.INCM_TAX_AMT AS "incomeTax",p.REAL_PAY_AMT AS "netPay", p.VNDR_SPLY_AMT AS "vendorSupply" FROM TB_HR_MON_PAY p WHERE p.DEV_ID=#{id} AND p.PAY_YM <= #{month} ORDER BY p.PAY_YM DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT s.SKILL_NM FROM TB_HR_DEV_SKILL s WHERE s.DEV_ID=#{id} ORDER BY s.SORT_ORD,s.SKILL_NM
SELECT a.AREA_CD AS "code",a.UPPER_AREA_CD AS "parentCode" FROM TB_SY_ADM_AREA a
mapper.sql: SELECT l.RCMD_ID::text AS "recommendationId",l.RANK_ORD::int AS "rankOrder", CASE WHEN l.PROJ_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'project' ELSE 'opportunity' END AS "targetType", COALESCE(l.PROJ_ID,l.OPP_ID) AS "targetId",l.JOB_CD AS "jobCode", l.BGN_YM AS "startMonth",l.REQ_GRADE_CD AS "gradeCode",l.NEED_SN::int AS "needSn", l.DEV_ID AS "developerId",l.TOT_SCORE AS "totalScore",l.SCORE_DTL AS "scoreDetail", l.RCMD_RSN AS "reason",l.USER_ACT_CD AS "userActCode",l.RCMD_EXCL_CD AS "reasonCode", l.ACT_USER_ID AS "actedBy",l.ACT_DTTM AS "actedAt" FROM TB_SL_RCMD_LOG l
mapper.select: WHERE l.RCMD_ID=CAST(#{id} AS numeric) AND l.RCMD_TYPE_CD='AI' ORDER BY l.RANK_ORD
WHERE l.RCMD_ID=CAST(#{id} AS numeric) AND l.DEV_ID=#{developerId} AND l.RCMD_TYPE_CD='AI'
WHERE l.RCMD_ID=CAST(#{id} AS numeric) AND l.DEV_ID=#{developerId} AND l.RCMD_TYPE_CD='AI' FOR UPDATE OF l
SELECT a.ASGN_ID AS "assignmentId",a.DEV_ID AS "developerId",a.PROJ_ID AS "projectId" FROM TB_PJ_ASGN a WHERE a.ASGN_ID=#{id}
